legend_note: A basket of 20 everyday services — health, food, schools, public services, daily needs — counted inside the commune boundary. The median commune has 4. This is what is in walking distance, not what is reachable: most people in a low-scoring commune drive ten minutes to a neighbouring one.

label: Service provision class
legend_note: The 0–20 basket score cut into five classes. 17.8% of communes score 0 or 1. Class boundaries come from the real distribution and are declared in source.yaml, not derived from any official definition of a service desert.

label: Health services present (0–5)
legend_note: GP, pharmacy, nurse, dentist and physiotherapist. Only about a quarter of metropolitan communes have a GP, and the darkest class is exactly zero of the five. Counting inside boundaries overstates isolation — but the pattern of where the zeros cluster is the point.
